citation: S. P. Ong, L. Wang, B. Kang, G. Ceder, "Li-Fe-P-O2 phase diagram from first principles calculations", Chem. Mater. 20, 1798 (2008)
usedFor: Convex-hull construction of a compositional phase diagram and the energy above the hull, as implemented in pymatgen (module 11, Screening Studio page)
notes: The Studio does not compute the hull; it shows the energy above hull stored in the dataset (S-044 field energy_above_hull)
